channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Garrison Mathews | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Garrison Mathews from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Garrison Mathews
item.description:
Dejounte Murray, on Garrison Mathews blossoming in his role:

“I mean, number one, he's a great person. I love him a lot, just the person that he is, and his work ethic speaks for itself.”

Dejounte Murray on Garrison Mathews, Apr 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Bradley Beal, Garrison Mathews
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on why Garrison Mathews is starting with Bradley Beal out:

“He gives us the best chance to make shots. He's one of our best shooters.... we need some of those shooters on the floor with Russ.”

Scott Brooks on Bradley Beal, Garrison Mathews, Feb 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Garrison Mathews
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on Garrison Mathews:

“He's one of the hardest working kids I've been around. He just keeps fighting.”

Scott Brooks on Garrison Mathews, Feb 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Justin Robinson, Admiral Schofield, Garrison Mathews
item.description:
“There’s guys, the four rookies that we have, Rui, Admiral, we added Justin Robinson, we added Garrison Mathews, they all played for great college coaches, great programs, three-year players minimum. They’re rookies, but by pedigree they’ve accomplished a great deal, so they’re coming in the door, we’re not starting remedial basketball.”

Tommy Sheppard on Justin Robinson, Admiral Schofield, Garrison Mathews, Sep 24, 2019. Source: Washington Post.
